alerts.detail: the falls are treacherous someone else died there just a few weeks ago while climbing through the falls and fell 40 ft onto the flat rock at the bottom. be very careful. I don't like climbing down these falls. you will need to lower your gear by rope, I have never found a portage trail that a canoe can go down.
